completed_task_notes.NEX-039: The first real DecisionProvider adapter, so decisioning stops being a capability the platform can exercise but never use. Product commit 8e670a6, CI 4/4 completed/success at that exact SHA (polled 2026-11-25T19:32Z). Four refusals carry the security argument: a vendor cannot abstain (no 'abstained' outcome on the wire; the caller's threshold decides), the request carries only kind plus sorted candidates (no context hash, no excluded field names, no correlation id), sorting makes order-independence a property of this adapter rather than a hoped-for vendor trait, and a bad answer is an abstention rather than an exception. Construction fails closed on a non-https endpoint or an unbounded name. Two honest limits are recorded in the module docstring: the response size bound is enforced after httpx has read the body, and a rationale is truncated rather than treated as fatal.
